chronotype.rationale: Late-chronotype genotype — peak strength, power, and reaction-time performance shifts later in the day. Avoid 06:00 sessions if performance matters; reserve early hours for low-intensity work.

concurrent_training.rule: Separate strength and endurance by ≥6 h on same day, or alternate days. Keep weekly endurance ≤ 90 min total when in a strength block.

daily_readiness.formula: Daily readiness (0-100) = 0.30·HRV_norm + 0.25·Sleep_norm + 0.15·RestingHR_norm + 0.15·SubjectiveEnergy + 0.10·Soreness_inverse + 0.05·Mood. Each component normalized vs your 14-day rolling baseline.

thresholds.action: Green — push hard. PRs encouraged. Heavy day or VO2max.
Yellow — normal session, hold RPE ≤8. Skip max efforts.
Orange — reduce volume 30%. Easy aerobic or technique work only.
Red — full rest or 20 min walk. Forcing it now buys nothing.

daily_readiness.tracking: Daily HRV (rMSSD on waking via Whoop/Oura/HRV4Training), resting HR, subjective 1-5 sliders for energy/soreness/mood. Take a 14-day baseline before computing deviations. 3 consecutive days <baseline = mandatory deload.

deload.trigger_signals: If you see: HRV ↓ >7% for 3+ days, RPE drift (same load feels harder), sleep quality dropping, joint pain accumulating, plateau in PRs ≥ 2 weeks → deload immediately, don't wait for the scheduled one.

fat_loss.guidance: FTO obesity-risk allele — GOOD NEWS: large studies show ≥150 min/week of moderate aerobic exercise NEUTRALISES the FTO weight-gain effect. Aerobic exercise is non-negotiable. strength_trainability.recommendation: Hypertrophy genes lean low — focus on strength (3–6 reps, heavy) where neural adaptations drive bigger early gains, plus high-volume blocks (8–12 weeks) for body composition. Consistency beats genes.

stress_fracture.guidance: Elevated stress-fracture risk markers — for runners/jumpers: ramp running mileage ≤10%/week, alternate impact days with cycling/swim, prioritize vitamin D ≥40 ng/mL, calcium 1000 mg/day, and bone-loading strength work (heavy squats, jumps) 2×/week — these strengthen bone more than running.

thermal_adaptation.cold_protocol: Cold exposure 2-3 min @ 50-59 °F (10-15 °C) 3-5×/wk pre-breakfast — increases brown-fat activity over 4-6 weeks (Søberg protocol: 11 min/wk minimum across multiple sessions). Avoid IMMEDIATELY post-strength training (blunts hypertrophy adaptation 12+ h).
thermal_adaptation.heat_protocol: Sauna 80-90 °C, 20-30 min, 3-4×/wk post-exercise — heat-shock protein induction, plasma volume +7%, cardiac output adaptation. Endurance performance improves ~7% in trained athletes after 10 sauna sessions (Scoon et al). Rehydrate 1.5× sweat lost.

alcohol.guidance: No alcohol-risk variants typed — standard moderation applies (≤1-2 drinks/day for men, ≤1 for women).

antioxidants.guidance: Standard endogenous antioxidant capacity — a normal varied diet suffices. Aim for diverse plant colors weekly.

b12.guidance: Variants in B12 transport/secretor status — prioritize high-bioavailable B12 sources: clams, beef liver, sardines, eggs, dairy. Consider 500 µg methylcobalamin sublingual 2–3×/week if vegetarian/vegan.

caffeine.guidance: Slow metaboliser — caffeine half-life prolonged (8+ h). Cap at 200 mg/day (≈ 1 large coffee) and avoid after lunch. Higher dose links to elevated CV risk in slow metabolisers. L-Theanine 100-200 mg paired with caffeine smooths anxiety response.

caloric.guidance: Compute TDEE from formula. For fat loss: subtract 400–500 kcal (smaller deficit if appetite-elevated genotype — sustainability beats speed). For lean gain: +250 kcal with strength training. Protein floor regardless of goal: 1.6–2.0 g/kg body weight, distributed across 3–4 meals.
caloric.tdee_formula: Mifflin-St Jeor: BMR(♂) = 10·kg + 6.25·cm − 5·age + 5; (♀) −161. TDEE = BMR × activity (1.4 sedentary, 1.55 moderate, 1.75 active, 1.9 athlete).

Pairing with 25-30 g protein + 10 g fiber + healthy fat blunts glucose excursion 30-50%.

histamine.guidance: Normal histamine clearance — fermented and aged foods well tolerated; they contribute meaningfully to gut-microbiome diversity.

hydration.guidance: Baseline: 30–35 mL/kg body weight daily, +500–750 mL per hour exercise. Salt-sensitive: pre-load 500 mL water on waking; emphasize potassium-rich fluids (coconut water, broth) over electrolyte powders.

inflammation.guidance: Mediterranean pattern with 2× weekly fish, daily berries + nuts, 1 tsp turmeric, minimize processed foods.

travel_jetlag.header: 5-step protocol to compress jet-lag adjustment from 1 day/timezone to ~half.

steps.action: Begin shifting meal times 1 h/day toward destination. East travel: earlier; west: later. Hydrate aggressively. Stop caffeine 8 h before intended sleep window.

Set watch to destination time immediately. Eat ONLY at destination meal times — even if not hungry, force a small protein-fat meal. Skip the in-flight cocktail (alcohol worsens circadian disruption). 240-360 mL water per hour.
First destination-morning meal: heavy protein (30 g) + caffeine + 10-15 min sunlight exposure. Anchors cortisol awakening response to new time zone.

Carb-leaning dinner finished by 19:00 local. Tryptophan-rich (turkey, salmon, pumpkin seeds) + complex carbs to spike serotonin → melatonin conversion. Melatonin 0.3-0.5 mg 4 h before intended sleep — micro-dose, not the 3-5 mg sold OTC (too much sedates without phase-shifting).
Maintain destination meal timing strictly. Don't nap >20 min before 14:00 local. Daily morning sunlight 15 min. Caffeine cutoff 8 h before intended bedtime.

supplements_considered: Melatonin 0.3 mg micro-dose 4 h before bed at destination
L-theanine 200 mg with caffeine for smoother wake-up
Electrolyte mix on flight — dehydration amplifies jet-lag fatigue

salt.guidance: Reduce sodium to ≤2.3 g/day; emphasize potassium-rich foods (leafy greens, beans, potato). DASH-style pattern especially beneficial.

satiety.guidance: High-satiety eating pattern is critical. Anchor every meal with: (1) 30–40 g protein (eggs, Greek yoghurt, fish, lean meat, tofu), (2) 8–10 g fiber (legumes, berries, vegetables), (3) volume from non-starchy veg. Front-load calories to breakfast/lunch; keep dinner lighter. Avoid liquid calories (juice, smoothies as meals — they bypass satiety). Pre-meal water 500 mL + salad reduces total intake. 12-hour overnight fast helps; longer (16:8) only if it doesn't trigger evening binges.

saturated_fat.guidance: APOE ε4 carrier — markedly elevated LDL response to saturated fat. Cap saturated fat at ≤15 g/day (~7% of calories). Replace butter/coconut oil with extra-virgin olive oil and avocado; limit red meat to 1–2×/week, choose poultry/fish. Prioritize MUFA (olive, avocado, almonds) and PUFA (walnuts, fatty fish). Mediterranean pattern is best-evidence.
